meta.title: Judgment
meta.description: No one can lie before God.

units.rawText: Inside the Reverse Babylon Tower.
units.displayText: Inside the Reverse Babylon Tower.

spans.text: Inside the Reverse Babylon Tower.

units.rawText: (Coughs and winces)
units.displayText: Coughs and winces

spans.text: Coughs and winces

units.rawText: It... it's Lady Angelus!
units.displayText: It... it's Lady Angelus!

spans.text: It... it's Lady Angelus!

units.rawText: Lady Angelus, are you well? ...What happened?
units.displayText: Lady Angelus, are you well? ...What happened?

spans.text: Lady Angelus, are you well? ...What happened?

units.rawText: Make way.
units.displayText: Make way.

spans.text: Make way.

units.rawText: There is a hint of coldness on her typically kind and gentle face.
units.displayText: There is a hint of coldness on her typically kind and gentle face.

spans.text: There is a hint of coldness on her typically kind and gentle face.

units.rawText: Love is in charge of the Divine Restoration today... I'll go ask her to prepare right now...
units.displayText: Love is in charge of the Divine Restoration today... I'll go ask her to prepare right now...

spans.text: Love is in charge of the Divine Restoration today... I'll go ask her to prepare right now...

units.rawText: No, healing isn't a priority.
units.displayText: No, healing isn't a priority.

spans.text: No, healing isn't a priority.

units.rawText: Huh? But your wounds look very severe...
units.displayText: Huh? But your wounds look very severe...

spans.text: Huh? But your wounds look very severe...

units.rawText: There is something more important than these paltry wounds.
units.displayText: There is something more important than these paltry wounds.

spans.text: There is something more important than these paltry wounds.

units.rawText: Go to the highest levels of the Sanctuary and find Lord Eosphorous.
units.displayText: Go to the highest levels of the Sanctuary and find Lord Eosphorous.

spans.text: Go to the highest levels of the Sanctuary and find Lord Eosphorous.

units.rawText: Ah... Is it serious enough that Lord Eosphorous needs to be involved...
units.displayText: Ah... Is it serious enough that Lord Eosphorous needs to be involved...

spans.text: Ah... Is it serious enough that Lord Eosphorous needs to be involved...

units.rawText: Also, find that Eucharist for me!
units.displayText: Also, find that Eucharist for me!

spans.text: Also, find that Eucharist for me!

units.rawText: L... Lady Eucharist?
units.displayText: L... Lady Eucharist?

spans.text: L... Lady Eucharist?

units.rawText: Go now!
units.displayText: Go now!

spans.text: Go now!

units.rawText: ...At once!
units.displayText: ...At once!

spans.text: ...At once!

units.rawText: I'd like to hear what excuses she's going to make for herself.
units.displayText: I'd like to hear what excuses she's going to make for herself.

spans.text: I'd like to hear what excuses she's going to make for herself.

units.rawText: Please hurry, Lady Eucharist! Lady Angelus was very worried!
units.displayText: Please hurry, Lady Eucharist! Lady Angelus was very worried!

spans.text: Please hurry, Lady Eucharist! Lady Angelus was very worried!

units.rawText: I'm coming, I'm coming, quit rushing me!
units.displayText: I'm coming, I'm coming, quit rushing me!

spans.text: I'm coming, I'm coming, quit rushing me!

units.rawText: Honestly, why's Big Sis Angelus so...
units.displayText: Honestly, why's Big Sis Angelus so...

spans.text: Honestly, why's Big Sis Angelus so...

units.rawText: Before Eucharist can finish speaking, she enters the Sanctuary and sees the wound-covered Angelus staring at her. And upon the throne behind Angelus shines the light of the morning star.
units.displayText: Before Eucharist can finish speaking, she enters the Sanctuary and sees the wound-covered Angelus staring at her. And upon the throne behind Angelus shines the light of the morning star.

spans.text: Before Eucharist can finish speaking, she enters the Sanctuary and sees the wound-covered Angelus staring at her. And upon the throne behind Angelus shines the light of the morning star.

units.rawText: Oh? Looks like Big Sis Angelus had a hard time in the Enigma Sector too.
units.displayText: Oh? Looks like Big Sis Angelus had a hard time in the Enigma Sector too.

spans.text: Oh? Looks like Big Sis Angelus had a hard time in the Enigma Sector too.

units.rawText: ...You seem pretty smug, aren't you, Eucharist?
units.displayText: ...You seem pretty smug, aren't you, Eucharist?

spans.text: ...You seem pretty smug, aren't you, Eucharist?

units.rawText: Uwah, you look so mean, Big Sis.
units.displayText: Uwah, you look so mean, Big Sis.

spans.text: Uwah, you look so mean, Big Sis.

units.rawText: Allowing intruders to barge into a sector, deliberately losing to them...
units.displayText: Allowing intruders to barge into a sector, deliberately losing to them...

spans.text: Allowing intruders to barge into a sector, deliberately losing to them...

units.rawText: And after that, knowingly betraying your mission and ignoring events that might have led to the destruction of a sector...
units.displayText: And after that, knowingly betraying your mission and ignoring events that might have led to the destruction of a sector...

spans.text: And after that, knowingly betraying your mission and ignoring events that might have led to the destruction of a sector...

units.rawText: And even keeping me from cleansing those Daemons...
units.displayText: And even keeping me from cleansing those Daemons...

spans.text: And even keeping me from cleansing those Daemons...

units.rawText: Do you have anything to say in your defense regarding these acts?
units.displayText: Do you have anything to say in your defense regarding these acts?

spans.text: Do you have anything to say in your defense regarding these acts?

units.rawText: Here, in front of Lord Eosphorous...
units.displayText: Here, in front of Lord Eosphorous...

spans.text: Here, in front of Lord Eosphorous...

units.rawText: Explain to me the motives you are harboring!
units.displayText: Explain to me the motives you are harboring!

spans.text: Explain to me the motives you are harboring!

units.rawText: Angelus grits her teeth as her voice rises a few octaves, and her wounds ooze more operands and data due to her anger.
units.displayText: Angelus grits her teeth as her voice rises a few octaves, and her wounds ooze more operands and data due to her anger.

spans.text: Angelus grits her teeth as her voice rises a few octaves, and her wounds ooze more operands and data due to her anger.

units.rawText: W-What the heck!
units.displayText: W-What the heck!

spans.text: W-What the heck!

units.rawText: Angelus, calm yourself a little.
units.displayText: Angelus, calm yourself a little.

spans.text: Angelus, calm yourself a little.

units.rawText: ...Yes. My apologies, I should not have allowed myself to be ruled by my emotions.
units.displayText: ...Yes. My apologies, I should not have allowed myself to be ruled by my emotions.

spans.text: ...Yes. My apologies, I should not have allowed myself to be ruled by my emotions.

units.rawText: While the testimony of one party is not enough to determine guilt, do you have any arguments you wish to offer in rebuttal, Eucharist?
units.displayText: While the testimony of one party is not enough to determine guilt, do you have any arguments you wish to offer in rebuttal, Eucharist?

spans.text: While the testimony of one party is not enough to determine guilt, do you have any arguments you wish to offer in rebuttal, Eucharist?

units.rawText: Ah, well, since you've said as much, Lord Eosphorus, there IS one thing I'd like to ask Big Sis Angelus.
units.displayText: Ah, well, since you've said as much, Lord Eosphorus, there IS one thing I'd like to ask Big Sis Angelus.

spans.text: Ah, well, since you've said as much, Lord Eosphorus, there IS one thing I'd like to ask Big Sis Angelus.

units.rawText: Is our mission and purpose not to utterly cleanse and purify Daemons?
units.displayText: Is our mission and purpose not to utterly cleanse and purify Daemons?

spans.text: Is our mission and purpose not to utterly cleanse and purify Daemons?

units.rawText: Indeed. No, what are you trying to say?
units.displayText: Indeed. No, what are you trying to say?

spans.text: Indeed. No, what are you trying to say?

units.rawText: In that case, why did you ultimately choose to retreat? Why did you not struggle with those Exiles until the very end?
units.displayText: In that case, why did you ultimately choose to retreat? Why did you not struggle with those Exiles until the very end?

spans.text: In that case, why did you ultimately choose to retreat? Why did you not struggle with those Exiles until the very end?

units.rawText: Frankly speaking, you need to take responsibility for the loss of permissions to the Enigma Sector, Big Sis Angelus!
units.displayText: Frankly speaking, you need to take responsibility for the loss of permissions to the Enigma Sector, Big Sis Angelus!

spans.text: Frankly speaking, you need to take responsibility for the loss of permissions to the Enigma Sector, Big Sis Angelus!

units.rawText: <size=40>...YOU!</size>
units.displayText: ...YOU!

spans.text: ...YOU!

units.rawText: Isn't that so? Hehe, I saw it all, you know!
units.displayText: Isn't that so? Hehe, I saw it all, you know!

spans.text: Isn't that so? Hehe, I saw it all, you know!

units.rawText: Big Sis Angelus, deep in your heart, don't you feel that these Exiles aren't the same as typical Daemons?
units.displayText: Big Sis Angelus, deep in your heart, don't you feel that these Exiles aren't the same as typical Daemons?

spans.text: Big Sis Angelus, deep in your heart, don't you feel that these Exiles aren't the same as typical Daemons?

units.rawText: I just...
units.displayText: I just...

spans.text: I just...

units.rawText: Hm? And why is that?
units.displayText: Hm? And why is that?

spans.text: Hm? And why is that?

units.rawText: As for me, I think they're very special.
units.displayText: As for me, I think they're very special.

spans.text: As for me, I think they're very special.

units.rawText: Lord Eosphorous!
units.displayText: Lord Eosphorous!

spans.text: Lord Eosphorous!

units.rawText: It is fine, Angelus. Let her finish.
units.displayText: It is fine, Angelus. Let her finish.

spans.text: It is fine, Angelus. Let her finish.

units.rawText: ...Yes.
units.displayText: ...Yes.

spans.text: ...Yes.

units.rawText: Hehe, after visiting so many sectors, don't you feel it too, Big Sis Angelus?
units.displayText: Hehe, after visiting so many sectors, don't you feel it too, Big Sis Angelus?

spans.text: Hehe, after visiting so many sectors, don't you feel it too, Big Sis Angelus?

units.rawText: Unlike normal Daemons, these Exiles didn't simply "devour" operands after obtaining sector permissions.
units.displayText: Unlike normal Daemons, these Exiles didn't simply "devour" operands after obtaining sector permissions.

spans.text: Unlike normal Daemons, these Exiles didn't simply "devour" operands after obtaining sector permissions.

units.rawText: On the contrary, these sectors have been doing very well under their protection.
units.displayText: On the contrary, these sectors have been doing very well under their protection.

spans.text: On the contrary, these sectors have been doing very well under their protection.

units.rawText: But without the protection of we Sanctifiers, other Daemons will be able to invade those sectors easily!
units.displayText: But without the protection of we Sanctifiers, other Daemons will be able to invade those sectors easily!

spans.text: But without the protection of we Sanctifiers, other Daemons will be able to invade those sectors easily!

units.rawText: That's up to them, then.
units.displayText: That's up to them, then.

spans.text: That's up to them, then.

units.rawText: You — This is blasphemy against our calling!
units.displayText: You — This is blasphemy against our calling!

spans.text: You — This is blasphemy against our calling!

units.rawText: But I want to know how much they can do, you know?
units.displayText: But I want to know how much they can do, you know?

spans.text: But I want to know how much they can do, you know?

units.rawText: Even so, you can't place all of Magrasea in danger for your laughable curiosity!
units.displayText: Even so, you can't place all of Magrasea in danger for your laughable curiosity!

spans.text: Even so, you can't place all of Magrasea in danger for your laughable curiosity!

units.rawText: Aw, it's not that bad, is it?
units.displayText: Aw, it's not that bad, is it?

spans.text: Aw, it's not that bad, is it?

units.rawText: ...Lord Eosphorous!
units.displayText: ...Lord Eosphorous!

spans.text: ...Lord Eosphorous!

units.rawText: Eucharist has neglected her duties, and by our regulations, she ought to be punished!
units.displayText: Eucharist has neglected her duties, and by our regulations, she ought to be punished!

spans.text: Eucharist has neglected her duties, and by our regulations, she ought to be punished!

units.rawText: (Snicker) ...What a dangerous term to throw around. Big Sis Angelus, can you really bear to do it?
units.displayText: (Snicker) ...What a dangerous term to throw around. Big Sis Angelus, can you really bear to do it?

spans.text: (Snicker) ...What a dangerous term to throw around. Big Sis Angelus, can you really bear to do it?

units.rawText: You keep your mouth shut...
units.displayText: You keep your mouth shut...

spans.text: You keep your mouth shut...

units.rawText: That will do. Angelus, Eucharist, I understand your opinions.
units.displayText: That will do. Angelus, Eucharist, I understand your opinions.

spans.text: That will do. Angelus, Eucharist, I understand your opinions.

units.rawText: I should not be punishing Eucharist.
units.displayText: I should not be punishing Eucharist.

spans.text: I should not be punishing Eucharist.

units.rawText: Lord Eosphorous... Why?
units.displayText: Lord Eosphorous... Why?

spans.text: Lord Eosphorous... Why?

units.rawText: ..Is it because I am of the Hesperus Faction? With all due respect — Surely you are not sheltering her, are you?
units.displayText: ..Is it because I am of the Hesperus Faction? With all due respect — Surely you are not sheltering her, are you?

spans.text: ..Is it because I am of the Hesperus Faction? With all due respect — Surely you are not sheltering her, are you?

units.rawText: ...Angelus.
units.displayText: ...Angelus.

spans.text: ...Angelus.

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus is doing battle at the frontlines, and he relies entirely on you to maintain the stability of the Reverse Tower—
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus is doing battle at the frontlines, and he relies entirely on you to maintain the stability of the Reverse Tower—

spans.text: Lord Hesperus is doing battle at the frontlines, and he relies entirely on you to maintain the stability of the Reverse Tower—

units.rawText: But if you ignore what is just and flagrantly absolve your subordinates of blame, then in future...
units.displayText: But if you ignore what is just and flagrantly absolve your subordinates of blame, then in future...

spans.text: But if you ignore what is just and flagrantly absolve your subordinates of blame, then in future...

units.rawText: I said it is fine, Angelus.
units.displayText: I said it is fine, Angelus.

spans.text: I said it is fine, Angelus.

units.rawText: I should not punish Eucharist, and neither should I absolve her.
units.displayText: I should not punish Eucharist, and neither should I absolve her.

spans.text: I should not punish Eucharist, and neither should I absolve her.

units.rawText: ...Huh?
units.displayText: ...Huh?

spans.text: ...Huh?

units.rawText: What Eucharist should have is a fair trial.
units.displayText: What Eucharist should have is a fair trial.

spans.text: What Eucharist should have is a fair trial.

units.rawText: Saying so, Eosphorous turns to Eucharist.
units.displayText: Saying so, Eosphorous turns to Eucharist.

spans.text: Saying so, Eosphorous turns to Eucharist.

units.rawText: (Groans) ...Lord, Lord Eosphorous?
units.displayText: (Groans) ...Lord, Lord Eosphorous?

spans.text: (Groans) ...Lord, Lord Eosphorous?

units.rawText: It seems you do not deny the charges Angelus has leveled against you.
units.displayText: It seems you do not deny the charges Angelus has leveled against you.

spans.text: It seems you do not deny the charges Angelus has leveled against you.

units.rawText: I have no intention of inquiring into your motives, but I must know the nature of your transgressions.
units.displayText: I have no intention of inquiring into your motives, but I must know the nature of your transgressions.

spans.text: I have no intention of inquiring into your motives, but I must know the nature of your transgressions.

units.rawText: From now on, you no longer have the privilege to leave the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: From now on, you no longer have the privilege to leave the Reverse Tower.

spans.text: From now on, you no longer have the privilege to leave the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: If your are found guilty of crimes at the trial, I will personally cleanse you.
units.displayText: If your are found guilty of crimes at the trial, I will personally cleanse you.

spans.text: If your are found guilty of crimes at the trial, I will personally cleanse you.

units.rawText: (Whimper)
units.displayText: Whimper

spans.text: Whimper

units.rawText: One who fills the seat of a Greater Sanctifier must shoulder the responsibilities of a Greater Sanctifier. Unfortunately, it seems you consider those responsibilities to be child's play.
units.displayText: One who fills the seat of a Greater Sanctifier must shoulder the responsibilities of a Greater Sanctifier. Unfortunately, it seems you consider those responsibilities to be child's play.

spans.text: One who fills the seat of a Greater Sanctifier must shoulder the responsibilities of a Greater Sanctifier. Unfortunately, it seems you consider those responsibilities to be child's play.

units.rawText: Hey, are you serious, Lord Eosphorous?
units.displayText: Hey, are you serious, Lord Eosphorous?

spans.text: Hey, are you serious, Lord Eosphorous?

units.rawText: I am speaking very seriously to you right now.
units.displayText: I am speaking very seriously to you right now.

spans.text: I am speaking very seriously to you right now.

units.rawText: ...No, I can't accept this!
units.displayText: ...No, I can't accept this!

spans.text: ...No, I can't accept this!

units.rawText: It is not up to you whether you accept it or not. That will be all, Eucharist.
units.displayText: It is not up to you whether you accept it or not. That will be all, Eucharist.

spans.text: It is not up to you whether you accept it or not. That will be all, Eucharist.

units.rawText: You must pay for what you have done.
units.displayText: You must pay for what you have done.

spans.text: You must pay for what you have done.

units.rawText: Take her away.
units.displayText: Take her away.

spans.text: Take her away.

units.rawText: After Eosphorous finishes, two Intermediate Sanctifiers nervously approach her. Eucharist looks like she wants to continue, but in the end she meekly bows her head and chooses to follow them outside.
units.displayText: After Eosphorous finishes, two Intermediate Sanctifiers nervously approach her. Eucharist looks like she wants to continue, but in the end she meekly bows her head and chooses to follow them outside.

spans.text: After Eosphorous finishes, two Intermediate Sanctifiers nervously approach her. Eucharist looks like she wants to continue, but in the end she meekly bows her head and chooses to follow them outside.

units.rawText: Angelus, you should hurry and heal yourself too.
units.displayText: Angelus, you should hurry and heal yourself too.

spans.text: Angelus, you should hurry and heal yourself too.

units.rawText: ...Yes.
units.displayText: ...Yes.

spans.text: ...Yes.

units.rawText: If I may ask one more thing... How do you intend to try Eucharist?
units.displayText: If I may ask one more thing... How do you intend to try Eucharist?

spans.text: If I may ask one more thing... How do you intend to try Eucharist?

units.rawText: With eyewitness testimony.
units.displayText: With eyewitness testimony.

spans.text: With eyewitness testimony.

units.rawText: I will clarify exactly what Eucharist has done.
units.displayText: I will clarify exactly what Eucharist has done.

spans.text: I will clarify exactly what Eucharist has done.

units.rawText: ...Very well.
units.displayText: ...Very well.

spans.text: ...Very well.

units.rawText: No matter how it turns out, this ought to be a satisfying conclusion. After eliminating the unstable elements, there will always be a chance later on to deal with those Exiles.
units.displayText: No matter how it turns out, this ought to be a satisfying conclusion. After eliminating the unstable elements, there will always be a chance later on to deal with those Exiles.

spans.text: No matter how it turns out, this ought to be a satisfying conclusion. After eliminating the unstable elements, there will always be a chance later on to deal with those Exiles.

units.rawText: She looks out the exit. As Eucharist is about to be led from the Pantheon, she looks back at the same time, and by coincidence their eyes meet.
units.displayText: She looks out the exit. As Eucharist is about to be led from the Pantheon, she looks back at the same time, and by coincidence their eyes meet.

spans.text: She looks out the exit. As Eucharist is about to be led from the Pantheon, she looks back at the same time, and by coincidence their eyes meet.

units.rawText: She had thought that this time, she would be able to see Eucharist's expression contort into resentment and discontent. However, the surprise is that Eucharist has a strange smile on her face...
units.displayText: She had thought that this time, she would be able to see Eucharist's expression contort into resentment and discontent. However, the surprise is that Eucharist has a strange smile on her face...

spans.text: She had thought that this time, she would be able to see Eucharist's expression contort into resentment and discontent. However, the surprise is that Eucharist has a strange smile on her face...

units.displayText: Angelus bites back her pain and strains to maintain her usual disposition as she ascends the stone steps to the Sanctuary.
